zigbee2mqtt.title: Zigbee2MQTT Configuration
zigbee2mqtt.description: ZigSight receives Zigbee2MQTT messages through Home Assistant's MQTT integration, so no broker settings are needed here. Enter the Zigbee2MQTT base topic (`mqtt.base_topic` in the Zigbee2MQTT configuration).

error.invalid_topic_prefix: Invalid base topic. Use a plain MQTT topic without wildcards, e.g. `zigbee2mqtt`.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of ZigSight is allowed

enable_zha_diagnostic_entities.name: Enable ZHA diagnostic entities
enable_zha_diagnostic_entities.description: Enables the LQI and RSSI diagnostic sensors of ZHA devices that are still disabled by their default. Never re-enables an entity a user disabled themselves. Home Assistant reloads the ZHA config entry ~30 seconds afterwards to create the newly enabled entities.

zha_diagnostics_disabled.title: ZHA LQI/RSSI sensors are disabled
zha_diagnostics_disabled.description: ZigSight found {count} ZHA link quality (LQI) / RSSI diagnostic sensor(s) still disabled by default. Call the `zigsight.enable_zha_diagnostic_entities` service (Developer Tools > Actions) to enable them; Home Assistant reloads the ZHA integration ~30 seconds afterwards to create the entities.

legacy_panel.title: Remove the old manual ZigSight panel setup
legacy_panel.description:
ZigSight now serves and registers its sidebar panel itself, but an old panel from a manual setup is still registered: {panels}.

That old copy of `zigsight-panel.js` is outdated, has known security issues (device names are rendered as HTML) and bugs, and can prevent the current panel from loading. To fix it:

1. Remove the `panel_custom:` entry for ZigSight (`url_path: zigsight` or `name: zigsight-panel`) from `configuration.yaml`.
2. Delete the copied files, e.g. `www/community/zigsight/` or `www/zigsight/`.
3. In Settings > Dashboards > Resources, replace resources pointing to `/local/.../zigsight/...` with `/zigsight_static/topology-card.js` or `/zigsight_static/topology-visualization.js`.
4. Restart Home Assistant.
